title: add-benchmark-lab-performance-suites-reporting-pipeline-v132
author: Ava Thompson
description: Adds v132 of the Benchmark Lab performance suites: expands representative workload runners, refreshes profiling baselines, and wires a new reporting pipeline that uploads per-run artifacts to the telemetry bucket and updates the performance dashboard. Motivation: recent model/kernel changes changed tokenization throughput and memory footprints across a subset of workloads; we need an updated canonical test suite and an automated reporting flow to detect regressions early. This PR: (1) Adds three new representative workload runners (webrtc_stress, multi_variant_sequence, long_context_translation) with configurable schedule/rate profiles; (2) Refreshes profiling baselines for kernel-selection experiments and adaptive batching (see baseline JSONs under benchmark-lab/profiles/); (3) Adds reporting pipeline steps and an integration test that validates end-to-end artifact upload and dashboard ingestion; (4) Improves CI matrix for perf tests to run lightweight smoke on PRs and full suites on nightly. Checklist: - [x] Workload runners implemented and unit tested - [x] Profiling baselines generated and checked in - [x] Reporting pipeline pipeline.yml changes and integration test added - [x] Docs updated with how to run local runners and interpret results - [x] SRE notified for bucket IAM changes Rollout notes: pipeline flips to new telemetry prefix via runtime flag telemetry.prefix=v132; default remains v131 until next deploy. No breaking changes to serving runtime API. See linked Linear tasks for followups (artifact retention policy, dashboard thresholds).
